product_one_liner.value: Envoy provides facility, security, and IT teams with a workplace-management platform for managing visitors, spaces, emergency response, and workplace communications and insights.
product_one_liner.notes: Summarizes Envoy’s stated platform capabilities and target teams.

pricing_page.notes: The public page presents plans and custom enterprise pricing.

named_customers.notes: Both appear as customer stories/case studies.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 463 employees, which falls in this band.

hq_location.notes: Envoy’s About page identifies San Francisco as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Envoy’s company profile states it was founded in 2013.

eng_blog.notes: The Builders index includes multiple engineering-authored posts about the product’s implementation, including AI threat detection and rendering React inside Ember.

public_docs.notes: Envoy provides a developer portal with step-by-step guides/API documentation and a multi-article help center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists 20 open roles; none has AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied/research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision in its title. A Senior Data Analyst role is not a data-science title under the stated rule.

model_provider.value: Envoy says Anthropic’s Claude is used for document parsing through Amazon Bedrock; AWS Rekognition is used for image/facial recognition in ID scanning and returning-visitor detection.
model_provider.notes: Envoy’s AI usage FAQ names the models/providers and the associated product features.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the compliance labels/reports displayed in Envoy’s Trust Center.

last_funding.notes: Funding sources report a $111 million Series C-II in January 2022 as the latest funding round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was in January 2022, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open listings include an EMEA Outbound BDR and a Mid Market Account Executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Envoy announced the launch of Envoy Response on August 6, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Envoy’s official release feed dates Mauricio Ramirez’s Chief Revenue Officer appointment announcement to July 28, 2026, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting lists SFDC, Outreach, ZoomInfo, and Nooks; the account-executive posting names Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 6Sense, and Chorus (with overlap deduplicated).
